d: India commemorates 18 years since the horrific 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks that claimed 166 lives and left more than 300 people injured. On November 26, 2008, 10 Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists launched coordinated attacks across Mumbai, targeting the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Nariman House and other locations.
